## Owner follow-on instruction — authorize bounded OFFLINE Codex implementation for Issue #81 (2026-10-18)

**Owner message in coordinator ChatGPT chat:** “so give me the prompt for codex and I approve any decision”.

**Scope interpretation:** This is approval to have **Codex implement Issue81's repository-only planning and evidence-preservation deliverables**, with discretion over *minor, reversible design choices inside this scope*. It is **not** an unbounded transfer of owner authority or a reversal of the owner's immediately preceding explicit prohibition of hosted access, dry-run, migration execution or PR merge. This is a coordinator relay from the owner's chat, not independent owner-authored GitHub approval/cryptographic identity proof.

**Authorized Codex implementation**:
1. Start from reverified `main` (last observed `fca0d96fd071f1165e3e16658d821a3d36a20293`, post-PR80 CI `39136089610` SUCCESS). Inspect Issue81, PR68/PR65, owner SQL definition decision [PR68 comment 6251764080](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/68#issuecomment-6251764080), exact independent PG17 evidence [Issue74 comment 6250984828](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/issues/74#issuecomment-6250984828), the current consolidated CI, current accepted ADR0008/AGENTS/governance.
2. Create a new isolated Codex-owned worktree/branch. Allocate a genuinely unused Task/CP/EB ID after checking **all active refs**, especially historical 0012 collisions; record this scoped owner direction/source. First commit Task, source snapshots and narrowly enumerated doc/report evidence allowlist; generate/validate/commit immutable pinned ContextPack **BEFORE** creating/editing operative report deliverables. No retrospective pack or overwriting an existing historical CP.
3. Write a **source-backed report/plan**, limited to `docs/reports/VEL-DB-READINESS-001-*.md` and, if necessary, a bounded sanitized provenance/evidence manifest under `docs/reports/evidence/VEL-DB-READINESS-001/*`, plus fresh `docs/agent-workflow/tasks/VEL-TASK-NEW.yaml`, `context-packs/VEL-CP-NEW.md`, `execution-bundles/VEL-EB-NEW.md`, `inputs/VEL-TASK-NEW/*`, and `docs/agent-workflow/PR-COMPLIANCE.yaml`. Update another path **only with separately explicit owner scope**. Exact allowed paths to be committed in the task before edits. Do not edit app, SQL/migrations, CI/scripts/tests, existing accepted policies, `AGENTS.md`, `LANGUAGE.md`, `CURRENT-STATE.md`, other PR branches or GitHub protection settings.
4. Deliver (a) audited PR68-vs-main file/provenance/conflict matrix, including PR65 original authorship and what old workflow edits to exclude; (b) documented **future** exact-target hosted-dev preflight/auth/CLI dry-run/migration acceptance checklist and stop conditions, **without running commands or connecting**; (c) sanitized, source-hash-linked synthetic PG17 artifact retention summary ahead of artifact #12139701246's Nov 1 expiry (no secrets, connection strings, real manuscripts or unsanitized command output); (d) owner-gate decision matrix for later separate permissions; and (e) FACT/INTERPRETATION/PROPOSAL report + ExecutionBundle/actual tests.
5. Check complete relevant local validation/metadata/PR-compliance and exact-head GitHub Actions, preserve diagnostics. Submit **new DRAFT PR** for ChatGPT independent source/CI review and separate owner merge decision. Report actual source/head SHAs and blocked items accurately. No assistant or coordinator code edits. Any meaningful scope conflict or source-hash drift => STOP/BLOCKED with evidence.

**Persisting hard holds (even with “approve any decision”):**
- NO hosted **Supabase access of any kind**, including read-only query/metadata inventory, Supabase CLI auth/`migration list`/`db push --dry-run`, credentials/keys, actual migrations/apply, test users or remote acceptance; NO remote production, deployments, paid/billing/settings actions, private manuscripts.
- NO rewriting the **already owner-approved exact SQL** blob `230b1540bb5b8962fd2b797d4f8a467d3c035978`, SHA256 `c7c384b6192d31e4e17c4f6e00978a16a4e15e2feeacfe148aaf1e2cd2853e81`. Definition approval is **NOT** execution permission.
- NO merging/changing state of PR68/65/66/59 or even the new planning PR; no direct changes to original history, no bypass of governance/security/CI.
- Human owner approval is reserved for future hosted preflight, actual hosted dev migration and two-author testing, migrations on production, PR merge, and release decisions.

This comment records the owner-scoped repository-only handoff **ready for direct Codex dispatch by the owner**. It does **not** claim Codex has been launched or the deliverables exist.
